note: Provisional. Canon is never minted in a concept register; the implementation audit censuses the catalog and adjudicates exact ids.

flags.note: Conductor routes every navigation through one dest-object grammar (route/cat/sub/managerId/objectId/tab/settingId). The existing navigate family covers it; no per-destination command ids are needed.
Numbered index entries are data, not commands; each is cmd.settings.navigate {dest}.

candidates.surface: ArrowLeft / Backspace anywhere in the workspace
candidates.behavior: Moves exactly one Settings level outward (editor -> section -> domain -> Home) and stops at Home.

candidates.surface: Enter / ArrowRight on a focused pane item
candidates.behavior: Activates the focused item's dest object; identical to clicking it.
Focuses the visible universal search field (large on Home, compact in the path bar elsewhere) and selects its text.

candidates.surface: Row activation in a section table
candidates.behavior: Routes to #/setting/<id>; the exact editor opens beneath the context row, never a modal. Back closes it.

candidates.surface: Reset to default button in the inline editor
candidates.behavior: store.setValue(id, inventoryDefault); the recent-change feed and receipt record it.

candidates.surface: Advanced disclosure bar in each section table
candidates.behavior: Discloses the advanced tier of the current subgroup; deep links auto-disclose when their target is advanced.

candidates.surface: Typed COPY confirm in the fourth copy panel
candidates.behavior: Arms the apply button only when the literal word COPY is typed; apply then runs the staged restore-point/apply/verify transaction.

candidates.surface: All Settings facet bar (category/type/tier/state/changed + text filter)
candidates.behavior: Filters the virtualized long-tail index without leaving the compendium; the window re-renders, never the whole list.
